definitions.explanation: Having abundant moisture and freshness. Describes fruits, vegetables, or plants that are plump with water and at peak freshness.
Having a youthful, radiant quality. Describes skin, appearance, or sensibility that seems young and vital.

examples.japanese: {瑞々|みずみず}しい⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought fresh vegetables at the market.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{梨|なし}→梨：13133_nashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{瑞々|みずみず}しくて⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧。
examples.english: This pear is juicy and sweet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{採|と}れ→採る：20862_toru⟧た⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レタス→レタス：05193_retasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{瑞々|みずみず}しくてシャキシャキ⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Lettuce picked fresh in the morning is juicy and crisp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{瑞々|みずみず}しい⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: She has a fresh, vibrant sensibility.

examples.japanese: {瑞々|みずみず}しい⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: To maintain youthful, dewy skin, daily moisturizing is important.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{瑞々|みずみず}しい⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}たれた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the young author's fresh, vibrant writing.

notes:
- {瑞々|みずみず}しい → {瑞々|みずみず}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (negative)
- {瑞々|みずみず}しい → {瑞々|みずみず}しく (adverbial form)
- {瑞々|みずみず}しい → {瑞々|みずみず}しかった (past)

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water), reduplicated to emphasize the quality of being full of water/moisture.

USAGE:
Sense 1 (physical freshness):
- {瑞々|みずみず}しい⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧ (fresh, juicy fruit)
- {瑞々|みずみず}しい⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ (lush greenery)

Sense 2 (youthful vitality):
- {瑞々|みずみず}しい⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (youthful, dewy skin)
- {瑞々|みずみず}しい⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧/⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧ (fresh sensibility/talent)

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana (みずみずしい) or with the kanji {瑞々|みずみず}しい. The kanji {瑞|みず} means 'auspicious' or 'felicitous.'

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {瑞々|みずみず}しくなかったら
